ANNEX 11
COMPUTERISED SYSTEMS
4. Validation
4.1 The validation documentation and reports should cover:
a. a description of the system;
b. acceptance criteria and test records;
14. Electronic Signature
Electronic records may be signed electronically. Electronic signatures are expected to:
c. include the time and date that they were applied.
